caption: The drawing features a square-shaped, intricate geometric pattern created with fine, light pencil or colored lines on a beige or off-white background. The main design comprises a grid of repeated squares, rectangles, and lines, forming an interlocking lattice that reveals smaller diagonal, crisscross, and checkered motifs within each section. The colors used are predominantly very light yellows, pale creams, and whites, giving the pattern a delicate and subtle appearance. At the lower left of the drawing, there is a handwritten annotation that reads "1' - 9"" followed by the name "E. Valentine." The overall composition centers the patterned square on the page, leaving a wide margin of blank space on all sides.
title: Coverlet
